title: ABVP holds student rally in Lucknow against political anarchy

tea.why: Protesters marched to oppose mob pressure, coercive politics, and attempts to bring about political changes outside of elections.
tea.want: They called for upholding democratic values, protecting constitutional institutions, and addressing electoral grievances through legal procedures.
tea.changed: Oct 18: Thousands of ABVP activists and students participated in a pro-democracy rally in Lucknow.

summary: On October 18, 2026, the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad organised a student rally in Lucknow under the slogan “Stop Anarchy, Embrace Democracy”. Thousands of students and ABVP members participated in the march, which moved between Lucknow University and Hazratganj. According to the organisers, the demonstration aimed to protect democratic values, support the independence of constitutional institutions, and address campus issues. Speakers argued that changes in government must occur exclusively through elections rather than through mob pressure or coercive politics. The organisation also addressed electoral roll revisions, urging that any irregularities be raised with evidence through constitutional channels rather than by pressuring institutions. No official government response was reported in the texts.
demands: Protect democratic values and constitutional institutions
Address electoral grievances through evidence and legal procedures
Promote democratic participation and accountability on campuses
response: No official response reported in the sources.
